'''Lorimar Lebauer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]], uncle of [[Ludlo Lebauer]], and the leader of the [[Invisible Shell]], a criminal organization. He was also a wanted [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] counterfeiter. At some point, Ludlo took over in his place as head of the Invisible Shell.
